svg.text: ST CALYPSO / THREE DECK GENERAL ARRANGEMENT
FIT-DRIVEN HULL / COMMON STATIONS / 1 m = 6 DRAWING UNITS
Hull driver: 19.0 m clear hold + structure = 20.0 m max beam. Aft ramp tapers to 14.0 m clear hatch in 15.0 m outer frame.
Forebody character: Accountant hull station taper. Deck +1 and Deck -1 usable slices pinch earlier than Deck 0 because the bow also tapers vertically.
Hold lock: 6.0 m catwalk/apron + 12.192 m C40 + 1.0 m gap + 4.0 m ramp = 23.192 m.
